Clarivest Asset Management LLC Has Raised Stake in Amdocs LTD (DOX)
July 12, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Clarivest Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Amdocs Ltd (DOX) by 98.69% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clarivest Asset Management Llc bought 151,138 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.12% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 304,275 shares of the edp services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $20.30M, up from 153,137 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clarivest Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Amdocs Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.39% or $0.94 during the last trading session, reaching $68.72. About 159,451 shares traded. Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) has risen 4.11% since July 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.46% the S&P500.
Clarivest Asset Management Llc, which manages about $3.41B and $5.81B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Unitedhealth Group Inc (NYSE:UNH) by 15,413 shares to 561,190 shares, valued at $120.10 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 40,835 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.48 million shares, and cut its stake in Kennametal Inc (NYSE:KMT).
Another recent and important Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) news was published by Nasdaq.com which published an article titled: “Vodafone India Uses Automation Powered by Amdocs Intelligent Operations to Improve Billing Efficiency” on June 26, 2018. Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) Ratings Coverage
Among 5 analysts covering Amdocs ( NASDAQ:DOX ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 60% are positive. Amdocs had 6 analyst reports since January 31, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Robert W. Baird maintained Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) rating on Wednesday, January 31. Robert W. Baird has “Hold” rating and $72.0 target. Oppenheimer maintained it with “Buy” rating and $77.0 target in Wednesday, January 31 report. The stock of Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) earned “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Monday, March 19. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, May 11 report. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, January 31 by Stifel Nicolaus.
